requests: Whether a 3300 PSI pressure washer can be used to apply the cleaner as a soft wash, given the stated preference to introduce the cleaner downstream rather than through the pump
Whether there is any reason not to use the pressure washer to apply the cleaner
The preferred method of applying the cleaner
reason: The reply covers all three requests: it says yes, the pressure washer can be used; it gives reasons not to (lifted wood fibers, moisture that takes days to dry before painting, ladder safety); and it names a preferred method (a brush on a painter's extension pole). It does not discuss downstream injection, but the author framed that as a preference rather than asking how to set it up, so it is not treated as a missing requirement. There is some uncertainty: if downstream dispensing were treated as a hard constraint, the label would be Partially answered.
label: Fully answered
